sloka: अथ अस्य चपला माता तत् स्व कर्म यथा तथम् ।तेन एव स्त्री स्वभावेन व्याहर्तुम् उपचक्रमे ॥२-७२-४६॥
transliteration: atha asya capalā mātā tat sva karma yathā tatham ।tena eva strī svabhāvena vyāhartum upacakrame ॥2-72-46॥

translations.english: ﻿ Then the capricious mother, with the same feminine disposition which she had displayed earlier, started giving a faithful account of all her deeds.
